components.name: MillerSelect
components.description: Miller-column picker, from the utilitek timesheet Work Performed field: sections as tabs, then group, header, and checkbox columns side by side, with a search that lists matches from every group. Opens as a popover on desktop and a bottom sheet on mobile, where the columns stack.

props.name: onChange
props.type: (groupId: string, selectedId: string | string[] | null) => void

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Trigger label. The selection count is added in brackets (default `Select`).

props.name: columnLabels
props.description: Column banner labels (default Groups, Headers, Options).

props.name: showClearAll
props.description: Shows Clear all when any group has a selection.

props.name: onClearAll
props.description: Clears everything in one call instead of one onChange per group.

props.name: popoverModal
props.description: Radix Popover modal mode. Use false inside a Dialog.

examples.title: no sections · compact · single owner
examples.code:
<MillerSelect
  compact
  columnLabels={["Field", "Group", "Pick"]}
  placeholder="Assign"
  groups={ASSIGNMENT_GROUPS}
  value={value}
  onChange={(groupId, selected) =>
    setValue((previous) => ({ ...previous, [groupId]: selected }))
  }
/>

examples.title: sections · work performed
examples.code:
<MillerSelect
  columnLabels={["Steps", "Substeps", "Activity"]}
  placeholder="Work performed"
  groups={WORK_PERFORMED_GROUPS}
  value={value}
  onChange={(groupId, selected) =>
    setValue((previous) => ({ ...previous, [groupId]: selected }))
  }
  onClearAll={() => setValue({})}
/>
